finalText: 99 dropped matches the ~100 flap events events.js generates (every 9th notification, same key, 2 minutes after the previous). Repeats within 5 minutes of the same key are now suppressed regardless of priority or quiet hours; a fresh delivery on any channel (including queue) resets the window. Verified via `node simulate.js`: 0 errors, drop count lines up with the flap rate.
